headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Jurassic Express vs. Swerve in our Glory vs. Hobbs & Starks fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.89 ? a well-worked match. Swerve in our Glory and Hobbs & Starks was challenging for gold for the very first time. It was the 40th time the AEW World Tag Team Titles had been on the line, a real landmark for that championship. Jurassic Express was chasing gold for the 10th time. A chaotic three-way tag team war ? Christian Cage's interference neutralized Team Taz's cheating attempts, letting Jurassic Express survive a flurry of near-falls to retain their titles.

Flash back to 2024, when Will Ospreay vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Hechicero vs. Jay White vs. Lio Rush vs. Mistico vs. Orange Cassidy vs. PAC vs. Shota Umino fought it out in a Casino Battle Royale match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.75 ? a war that left everything in the ring. In a nine-man Casino Gauntlet loaded with NJPW and CMLL stars, Ospreay outlasted the field with an Oscutter on Orange Cassidy to earn an AEW World Title shot against Strickland at Forbidden Door.

It was 2022 when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as CM Punk vs. Adam Page battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.93 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. For CM Punk, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. An emotional main event ? Punk's first world title win in over nine years, in a match that saw Page hesitate on a heel turn and pay for it, ending Page's reign in dramatic, tearful fashion.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: AEW welcomed Matt Menard for the first time in an Anarchy in the Arena match against Garcia, Hager & Jericho vs. Proud-N-Powerful & Kingston vs. 2.O vs. Danielson & Moxley vs. Proud-N-Powerful vs. Angelo Parker vs. Chris Jericho vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jake Hager vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Jon Moxley vs. Ortiz vs. Santana vs. Eddie Kingston, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 9.08 ? a genuine showstealer. Part of the Jericho Appreciation Society's chaotic, cinematic-style brawl against Moxley, Danielson, Kingston, Santana, and Ortiz ? a wild, alliance-testing war that further cemented Jericho's manipulative grip over his stable.
Flash back to 2022, when Kyle O'Reilly vs. Darby Allin met for the very first time on Double or Nothing, rated 7.48 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
On a Sunday in 2022, back when Thunder Rosa vs. Serena Deeb clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 7.33 ? a match that delivered.
